verdict.rationale: ELSTER documents its own sanctioned channel through which third-party tax software transmits filings over the same rail as the portal. That implies a programmatic interface for at least core tax submissions. Nothing shows that UI functions like receipt upload, Vollmachten, mailbox access, E-Rechnung submission or Bescheid retrieval are reachable through it, and the probe found the developer-artifact host timing out. missing for 10: a documented public API, evidence of UI–API feature parity, programmatic access to receipts/mailbox/notices/authorizations, accessible developer docs, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Sie können aber auch jede andere Steuersoftware verwenden, die ELSTER unterstützt.
any tax software that supports ELSTER transmits through the same rail
